caption: After the first upload Wistia offered a 14 day Business trial with no credit card. We chose Maybe later and stayed on Free.
Media info for the first upload: format Video, file size 32.2 KB, duration 0:10. The media ID, folder name and creator are hidden.
Description and tags saved on the Free plan. The media menu has Download and Replace; Add to Channel and A/B tests need a paid plan.
The download dialog offers MP4 at 540p, 360p or 288p. There is no option to download the original file.
Two test videos in a new folder. Under Access the folder default is Anyone with the link, Can view. The folder name is hidden.
Plans with Monthly selected: Business $99 a month, Business + Signals $412 a month, Enterprise custom.
Stripe checkout for Business in euro, billed monthly: 92.35 euros, with 886.52 euros a year as the annual option. Tax only appears after an address. We stopped before the card form.
